issues.description: Page is stuck in 'Analyzing your room...' loading state indefinitely. No furniture items are shown, no room image with orange overlays, no keep/remove toggles, and no Continue button. The page never transitions out of the loading skeleton.
issues.root_cause: The page likely reads pre_detection_result from localStorage/store and either: (1) the data is not present so loading state never resolves, or (2) there is a hydration mismatch causing the component to stay in skeleton state. The multiple hydration errors in console confirm server/client state mismatch, which likely causes the component to re-render on client with empty/missing data and stay stuck in loading.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. This causes the page to fully re-render on client and lose any SSR state, contributing to the stuck loading state.
issues.root_cause: The step-7c page likely accesses localStorage or browser-only APIs (like zustand store with localStorage persistence) during render without guarding with useEffect or isMounted pattern, causing server and client renders to differ.

fixes.reason: If loading state is initialized to true without a mechanism to set it false when data is already available, the page stays stuck. Setting it to false allows the component to render with available data immediately.
If the page uses a mounted guard that returns null on server, it causes hydration mismatch. Removing the null-return guard while keeping client-only data access in useEffect fixes hydration errors.
